author: IGN
description: Here's a look at the Announcement Trailer for Full Belly Breakout, a first-person, decision-based adventure game developed by Zxima.llc. Players will seek out what lies among the plethora of dishes to enjoy every bite and ultimately escape their cell. Full Belly Breakout is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Full Belly Breakout - Official Announcement Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Join narrative director Jeffrey Spock from developer Amplitude Studios for a deep dive into the Rogue Factions coming to Endless Legend 2 in the strategy game's 1.0 release. Learn about these playable Rogue Factions, which feature a new set of traits for a different strategic approach, quests, and more. The new video breaks down what to expect from the Order of Zelevas splinter faction of the Kin of Sheredyn and the Severed Claws splinter faction of the Necrophage. 

Version 1.0 of Endless Legend 2 will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, Xbox on PC, Xbox Series X/S, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on September 17, 2026.
title: Endless Legend 2 - Official Rogue Factions Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Escape From Playtime gets a new trailer showcasing gameplay and an early access release date. Watch the latest Escape From Playtime trailer for the upcoming co-op survival horror game set within the Poppy Playtime universe, deep inside the decaying halls of the abandoned Playtime Co. The new trailer features a creepy voiceover explaining what you need to do to survive. Escape From Playtime will be available in Steam Early Access on October 21, 2026.

In Excape From Playtime, players explore the facility as the Smiling Critters, the dead-eyed toy line with gaping smiles introduced in Poppy Playtime: Chapter 3. From classrooms and warehouses to testing labs and the dark corridors connecting them all, every space in the factory becomes more dangerous when seen from a Critter’s-eye view.

#ign #gaming
title: Escape From Playtime - Official Early Access Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description: Here's a look at ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer for Tempest Rising, a real-time strategy game developed by Slipgate Ironworks. Players can get a new look at the upcoming expansion that brings 11 new missions from the perspective of the Veti, a powerful and technologically advanced faction established in previous instances in the game. Take on ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion in Tempest Rising on September 29 for PC (Steam).
title: Tempest Rising - Official ‘The Veti’s Wrath’ Expansion Release Date Trailer

author: IGN
description: Happy's Humble Burger Cult gets an update that adds two new restaurants and the Trial by Fryer team-based PvP mode. Watch the latest Happy's Humble Burger Cult trailer to see what to expect with the Trial by Fryer update for the co-op cooking horror game. Face off against the enemy team in a surreal cooking show, sabotage their kitchen, fight for ingredients, and become the best team of chefs in Trial by Fryer. The Trial by Fryer update for Happy's Humble Burger Cult is available now on Steam.
title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult - Official Trial By Fryer Update Trailer

author: IGN
description: Take a look at the Game Overview Trailer for Blackwood, a third-person action-adventure game developed by AttritoM7 Productions. Players will run a DVD store by day and embody a ruthless assassin by night, with intense melee combat and tight gunplay. Get the rundown on the game's offerings with Blackwood, launching on September 16 for PC (Steam).
title: Blackwood - Official Game Overview Trailer

author: IGN
description: Meet two new survivors coming to Risk of Rain 2 in this latest trailer for the roguelike action game. The Acolyte is a close-range glaive-wielding Survivor who can wield powerful combos, but not without cost. The Enforcer is a defensive vanguard and a Survivor who combines powerful defense with dynamic, tactical movement. The Risk of Rain 2: Hallowed Concepts expansion will be available on Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S.
title: Risk of Rain 2 - Official Acolyte and Enforcer Survivors Reveal Trailer
